answer_result.answer: Dave picked up photography in October 2023.

question.question: Which hobby did Dave pick up in October 2023?

evidence_items.text:
Calvin: Hey Dave! Been ages since we chatted. So much has gone down. Touring with Frank Ocean last week was wild. Tokyo was unreal -- the crowd was insane. I felt so alive when performing, can't find the words to express it.
[S7T1] (dia_id: D7:1)

Dave: Wow, that's awesome, Cal! I bet it was an incredible experience. Congrats! Look what I've been up to recently, that's my neighbor's car. He's been having some trouble with the engine, but now it's done by myself!
[Image caption: a photo of a man working on a car engine in a garage]
[S7T2] (dia_id: D7:2)

Calvin: Thanks, Dave! It was an amazing experience - the energy and love from the fans was crazy. The car in the pic? It's the one you were fixing up the engine for a friend? Working on cars helps me chill and clear my head.
[S7T3] (dia_id: D7:3)

Dave: Yes, Cal! It's not difficult for me to help my neighbors with their cars. Working on cars is definitely therapeutic. Does it relax you as much as it does me?
[S7T4] (dia_id: D7:4)

Calvin: Yeah, totally! Fixing cars really calms me down and gives me a real sense of achievement - like meditating. Do you have any hobbies that give you the same satisfaction?
[S7T5] (dia_id: D7:5)

Dave: I'm passionate about fixing up things. It's more than just a hobby - it gives me a sense of achievement and purpose. I get a real buzz transforming something that's not working into something that runs smoothly - it's like giving it a second chance.
[S7T6] (dia_id: D7:6)

Calvin: That's so inspiring, Dave. You find purpose in transforming things – like when you create something new or collaborate with others. We're both making something great out of nothing, it's amazing, right?
[S7T7] (dia_id: D7:7)

Dave: Yeah Cal, it's kinda cool how we can take something and make it look amazing. Giving it a new life makes me feel powerful and happy - like I really achieved something.
[S7T8] (dia_id: D7:8)

Calvin: Yeah, Dave! That feeling of power and happiness is amazing! It's great to see what we created with all our hard work and ideas.
[S7T9] (dia_id: D7:9)

Dave: Yeah, Calvin! Accomplishment keeps me motivated. You mentioned Tokyo lit you up. Do you always enjoy performing live?
[S7T10] (dia_id: D7:10)

- The 2023-07-21 conversation continued: Dave asked how Calvin deals with the pressure of his music and stays motivated; Calvin said collaborating with others, learning from them, and surrounding himself with positive energy helps; Dave encouraged him — surrounding himself with good vibes and collaborating "will give you a boost", "You've achieved so much so far; keep going, buddy!" (Calvin's motivation details in /memories/calvin.md > ## Music) [S11T9][S11T10][S11T11].
- The conversation closed with Calvin thanking Dave — his support "means a lot to me" — and saying he's gonna keep pushing himself and striving for his goals; Dave replied "You got this! Keep pushing yourself and never lose sight of your goals. I'm your biggest fan. Let's chat soon!", and Calvin said "Thanks, Dave! Appreciate your support. Let's catch up soon and chat. Take care!" [S11T12][S11T13][S11T14].
- On 2023-08-11, caught up with Calvin ("been ages!"): Dave announced he got picked for a car mod workshop (a dream come true — he's always wanted to learn auto engineering and to work on building a custom car) and shared photos of the cars he's working with (a man in front of a car on a lift; a mechanic working on a car; a silver Corvette) (details in ## Car mod workshop (2023-08-11)). Calvin congratulated him and asked about the transformations he'd done so far and how the current project is going, and praised the modern twist the silver finish gives [S13T1][S13T2][S13T3][S13T5][S13T6][S13T7][S13T8].
- The 2023-08-11 conversation continued: Dave said his current project combines "a modern vibe but also that classic muscle car style", that he's "really happy with it", that the small details are what "make it unique and personalized", and that customizing it is "like a work of art on wheels" (details in ## Car mod workshop (2023-08-11)); Calvin praised his attention to detail and encouraged him to keep coming up with new cool stuff [S13T9][S13T10][S13T11][S13T12][S13T13][S13T14]. Dave then offered Calvin a hand with his music stuff — his music studio has a high-quality sound system (details in ## Music); Calvin thanked him, said he's "super busy with my music stuff at the moment", and will keep the offer in mind — "Great work, dude!" [S13T15][S13T16].
- The 2023-08-11 conversation ended with Dave telling Calvin "No worries... Got it. Good luck with your music!"; Calvin thanked him for the encouragement and said he'll keep working hard and making music, and Dave signed off "See ya, Calvin! Stay awesome. Catch ya later." [S13T17][S13T18][S13T19].

Calvin: Yay! Dave! We're hitting some awesome spots - it's gonna be epic!
[S18T9] (dia_id: D18:9)

Dave: That sounds awesome, Calvin! Live music is the best. I'm sure you're gonna have a blast on tour and make some awesome memories. If you ever want to check out my garage and see some cool cars, I'd love to show you around. Keep rockin'!
[S18T10] (dia_id: D18:10)

Calvin: Thanks, Dave! I'll definitely take you up on that offer. It would be fun to check out your garage and maybe even get some ideas for future projects. I'll let you know when I'm in Boston. Keep pursuing your passions and keep those cars rolling. You rock!
[S18T11] (dia_id: D18:11)

Dave: Thanks, Calvin! Appreciate the kind words and support. Can't wait for your visit! Take care and keep creating amazing music! Check out pic of my garage, it looks stunning!
[Image caption: a photo of a car in a garage with a coca cola sign]
[S18T12] (dia_id: D18:12)

Calvin: Thanks! I can't wait for your visit either. Take care and keep enjoying your hobbies!
[S18T13] (dia_id: D18:13)

Dave: Sure thing! Thanks again for your help. Bye! Have a great day.
[S18T14] (dia_id: D18:14)

Calvin: No problem! Always good chatting with you. Have an awesome day!
[S18T15] (dia_id: D18:15)

Dave: Thanks, Calvin! Catch you later. Have a great day!
[S18T16] (dia_id: D18:16)

evidence_items.section: # Dave > ## Hobbies and sense of purpose
evidence_items.text:
- On 2023-05-31, said working on cars is "definitely therapeutic" and that it is not difficult for him to help neighbors with their cars [S7T4].
- Passionate about fixing up things in general: "more than just a hobby" — it gives him a sense of achievement and purpose [S7T6].
- Gets "a real buzz" transforming something that's not working into something that runs smoothly — "like giving it a second chance" [S7T6].
- Giving something a new life "makes [him] feel powerful and happy — like [he] really achieved something"; he agreed with Calvin that they both "take something and make it look amazing" [S7T7][S7T8].
- On 2023-08-03, said fixing cars is like therapy for him; growing up he worked on cars with his dad, and refurbishing them gives him a sense of fulfillment [S12T2].
- On 2023-09-02, when telling Calvin he's been tied up with car stuff, said fixing stuff up and seeing it turn out better is "really rewarding and gives me a sense of purpose", and that fixing someone's car makes him feel like he's "making a difference"; he's made "proud" to see the relief on someone's face when their car is fixed (echoing his long-stated sense of purpose from fixing things, see above) [S17T3][S17T5].
- Has fond memories of working on cars with his dad as a kid: they spent one summer restoring an old car — "It was hard work, but seeing the end result and knowing that we did it together was really satisfying" [S12T4].
- Shared a photo from that time: a man and a child (Dave and his dad) posing for a picture — "a wonderful experience" [S12T6].

Calvin: Hey Dave, long time no see! I just took my Ferrari for a service and it was so stressful. I'm kinda attached to it. Can you relate? What kind of hobbies give you a feeling of being restored?
[S12T1] (dia_id: D12:1)

Dave: Hey Calvin, I understand the stress of getting a car serviced. Fixing cars is like therapy for me. Growing up working on cars with my dad, refurbishing them gives me a sense of fulfillment.
[S12T2] (dia_id: D12:2)

Calvin: Wow, Dave, that's awesome! Must feel great to have a hobby that makes you proud. Remember any good memories from working on cars with your dad?
[S12T3] (dia_id: D12:3)

Dave: Yeah, definitely! I have fond memories of working on cars with my dad as a kid. We spent one summer restoring an old car. It was hard work, but seeing the end result and knowing that we did it together was really satisfying.
[S12T4] (dia_id: D12:4)

Calvin: That's awesome, Dave! Working together on projects like that really brings people closer. Do you have any pictures from that time?
[S12T5] (dia_id: D12:5)

Dave: Yes, I have one, take a look. It was a wonderful experience.
[Image caption: a photography of a man and a child pose for a picture]
[S12T6] (dia_id: D12:6)

Calvin: Aww, that's cool, Dave. Reminiscing is always fun! That pic you shared takes me back to my trip to the Ferrari dealership. I saw a lot of amazing cars, but as for me, my car is the best and  I'm pretty proud of this. Sure, it's just material, but it reminds me of my hard work and dedication. It really inspires me. Take a look at this beauty!
[Image caption: a photography of a red car is lifted on a lift in a garage]
[S12T7] (dia_id: D12:7)

Dave: Your car looks great, Calvin! I can tell why you're proud. Having something like that is motivating. It's like a reminder of what you can achieve.
[S12T8] (dia_id: D12:8)

- On 2023-07-07, caught up with Calvin: asked how the car was doing after the crash, and Calvin said it's all good now — fixed and going strong (see the Car accident section of /memories/calvin.md). Dave said he's been good, hanging out with friends at parks — he's arranged regular walks with friends and shared a photo of the spot: a city skyline with a river and boats (details in ## Parks). Calvin shared photos of his Japanese mansion (backyard with a boat docked in a canal at sunset; the mansion front), and Dave marveled that the peace by the river is really nice and that the views from the mansion "must be amazing" (details in /memories/calvin.md > ## New home (2023-03-23)) [S10T1][S10T2][S10T3][S10T5][S10T6][S10T7][S10T8].
- The 2023-07-07 conversation continued: Calvin is looking forward to trying the Japanese food and checking out the culture; Dave has never been to Japan but is "so keen to go one day" and is "hooked on" Japanese music (details in ## Japan). Dave is excited about Calvin's collaborations with Japanese artists — "a great chance", "can't wait for the tunes!", "can't wait to see/hear the end product" — and Calvin promised to share clips and said he can't wait to show him. The conversation closed with Calvin thanking Dave for all the help ("Appreciate all the help"), saying "Great catching up, gotta get back to work now. Take care!" [S10T9][S10T10][S10T11][S10T12][S10T13][S10T14][S10T15][S10T16]. Dave signed off last: "Hey Cal, take care and don't overwork yourself! Talk to you soon. Stay safe!" [S10T17].
- On 2023-08-03, caught up with Calvin ("long time no see!"): Calvin told him his recent Ferrari service was so stressful (he's attached to the car) and asked what kind of hobbies give Dave a feeling of being restored; Dave said fixing cars is like therapy for him — growing up working on cars with his dad, refurbishing gives fulfillment — and shared his fond childhood memory of spending a summer with his dad restoring an old car (details in ## Hobbies and sense of purpose) [S12T1][S12T2][S12T4].
- The 2023-08-03 conversation continued: Dave shared a childhood photo of himself and his dad (a man and a child posing) from that car-restoring summer, and Calvin found it cool ("Reminiscing is always fun!"); Calvin then shared a photo of his red Ferrari on a lift in a garage, saying his car is the best and "reminds me of my hard work and dedication"; Dave said the car looks great, "I can tell why you're proud," and "it's like a reminder of what you can achieve" (details of Calvin's car in /memories/calvin.md > ## New luxury car (Ferrari, 2023-03-26)) [S12T5][S12T6][S12T7][S12T8].
- The 2023-08-03 conversation continued: Dave asked what Calvin's biggest goal is (music-wise or something else); Calvin said his plan for now is to expand his brand worldwide and grow his fanbase, and that working with artists from around the globe and challenging himself to create special music are goals of his too, and he shared a photo of performing with his band "the boys" the night before (2023-08-02) — a band playing on stage with lights on. Dave: "Working with different artists and crafting great sounds will definitely help you reach your goals. Keep it up and keep making a difference!" The conversation closed with Dave telling Calvin to "keep at it and never forget your dreams" and to "stay focused and keep going... You've got this!", and Calvin thanking Dave — his support "means a lot to me" (Calvin's goal details in /memories/calvin.md > ## Music) [S12T10][S12T11][S12T12][S12T13][S12T14][S12T15][S12T16].

Dave: Hey Calvin, been ages! Guess what? I got picked for a car mod workshop. Gonna get better at it and learn something new! Look at the cars I'm working with right now. 
[Image caption: a photography of a man standing in front of a car on a lift]
[S13T1] (dia_id: D13:1)

Calvin: Wow Dave, that's awesome! Congrats on being picked for the car mod workshop. It's a great opportunity to take your skills up a notch. Are there any mods or projects you're excited to work on?
[S13T2] (dia_id: D13:2)

Dave: Thanks, Calvin! This is a dream come true for me, as I've always wanted to learn auto engineering and work on building a custom car.
[S13T3] (dia_id: D13:3)

Calvin: That's awesome, Dave! Pursuing your passion for auto engineering and making a custom car is a great experience. I'm excited to see what you create. Keep it up and have fun every step of the way. What do you think is the most thrilling part of it?
[S13T4] (dia_id: D13:4)

Dave: Thanks, Calvin! I've found the picture with really thrilling part of the workshop, take a look. Seeing the potential come to life is always satisfying.
[Image caption: a photo of a car is being worked on by a mechanic]
[S13T5] (dia_id: D13:5)

Calvin: Wow, that sounds like a fulfilling hobby! What kind of transformations have you done so far? How's it going with the current project?
[S13T6] (dia_id: D13:6)

Dave: I've been working on this car, doing engine swaps and suspension modifications. Now I'm learning about body modifications. Giving this classic muscle car a modern twist is a challenge but so fun!
[Image caption: a photo of a silver corvette parked in front of a building]
[S13T7] (dia_id: D13:7)

Calvin: Wow, Dave, that looks cool! The silver finish gives it a modern twist. Great job!
[S13T8] (dia_id: D13:8)

Dave: Thanks, Calvin! Yeah, I wanted a modern vibe but also that classic muscle car style. Really happy with it!
[S13T9] (dia_id: D13:9)

Calvin: You've really put in some work! That attention to detail is great.
[S13T10] (dia_id: D13:10)

- As of 2023-05-31, had recently fixed a neighbor's car engine himself — the neighbor "had been having some trouble with the engine", which is now done; shared a photo of himself working on the car engine in a garage. (Calvin recognized the car as the one Dave had been fixing the engine of "for a friend.") [S7T2][S7T3].
- On 2023-10-15, told Calvin it's been "a crazy rollercoaster week": a competing car maintenance shop snagged a deal that Dave's shop had been trying to secure for months; he felt "kinda bummed out" and questioned whether his hard work is a waste — "I put in so much effort at work, but it feels like nothing. Am I wasting my time?"; Calvin encouraged him — "don't give up, keep pushing and believe in yourself. The payoff will be worth it." — and Dave said he's "gotta have faith and patience" and is "sure it's only a matter of time till things work out" [S23T1][S23T2][S23T3].
- On 2023-10-23, shared a photo of his garage (a garage with a bunch of tools hanging on the wall — "a little dirty, but everything is in its place") while telling Calvin that working on a car is his own outlet (details in the 2023-10-23 entry of ## Relationships and in ## Hobbies and sense of purpose) [S25T13].

Calvin: Hey Dave! Yesterday I met with some incredible artists in Boston and we talked about working together. It was such an inspiring and exciting experience - they all have individual styles and I'm stoked to collaborate with them on new music.
[S21T1] (dia_id: D21:1)

Dave: Awesome, Calvin! Connecting with all those talented artists must have been an inspiring experience. Can't wait to hear what you come up with in your collaboration. Let me know how it goes! Also, how did you arrange that meeting?
[S21T2] (dia_id: D21:2)

Calvin: Hey Dave, it was awesome talking to those artists! Our mutual friend knew we'd be a great fit. Can't wait to show you the final result. Also, check out this project - I love working on it to chill out. How about you? Got any hobbies to help you relax?
[Image caption: a photo of a shiny orange car with a hood open]
[S21T3] (dia_id: D21:3)

Dave: Wow, Calvin, that car looks great! Working on cars really helps me relax, it's therapeutic to see them come back to life. I've been working on that Ford Mustang I found in a junkyard - it was in bad shape, but I knew it had potential.
[S21T4] (dia_id: D21:4)

Calvin: Wow, Dave! It's awesome that you can bring things back to life. Do you have any pictures of it looking amazing? I'd love to see how it turned out!
[S21T5] (dia_id: D21:5)

Dave: Hey Calvin, check out this photo! I put in a lot of work restoring it, but the result is awesome. It's so satisfying to bring an old car back to life.
[Image caption: a photography of a red car parked in a field with other cars]
[S21T6] (dia_id: D21:6)

Calvin: We've been greatly privileged to have been granted this opportunity. It's so satisfying to bring it back to life! 
[Image caption: a photo of a person's hand with dirty hands next to a car]
[S21T7] (dia_id: D21:7)

Dave: Wow, it's so satisfying! Here are my hands after a day in the garage - permanently stained with grease. But it's worth it when you see the end result.
[Image caption: a photography of a person's hands with dirt on them]
[S21T8] (dia_id: D21:8)

Dave: Thanks, buddy. Your support really helps. It's great to have a friend who believes in me. I'll keep pushing.
[S23T13] (dia_id: D23:13)

Calvin: I believe in you, Dave. Keep pushing and never forget how awesome you are.
[S23T14] (dia_id: D23:14)

Dave: Thanks, Calvin! Your support means a lot. I'm gonna keep going and not forget my value!
[S23T15] (dia_id: D23:15)

Calvin: C'mon, remember how great you are! Keep going for those dreams. You got this! You know what Dave? Last week, I got a new Ferrari! It's a masterpiece on wheels. Excited for thrilling rides and unforgettable journeys! Perhaps a photo of this unique beauty will lift your mood.
[Image caption: a photography of a black sports car parked in front of a building]
[S23T16] (dia_id: D23:16)

Dave: Wow! Thanks a ton for the kind words and encouragement! Your positivity is contagious. Congratulations on the new Ferrari – that's incredible! Must be one amazing ride. I'm all in for those thrilling journeys! Feel free to share a pic of your new beauty whenever you're ready. Let's keep the good vibes rolling! Take care and see you later!
[S23T17] (dia_id: D23:17)

Calvin: The Ferrari is indeed a showstopper. I'll be sure to share a pic soon. Here's to more thrilling rides and positive vibes. Take care, and looking forward to catching up soon!
[S23T18] (dia_id: D23:18)

Calvin: Hey Dave! Since we last talked, I went to a networking event to meet more artists. So cool! The people I met will help me build up my fan base. Super excited about what it could lead to. You? Anything new since we last spoke?
[S27T1] (dia_id: D27:1)

Dave: Hey Calvin! That's cool that you've been networking with other artists. Nice! I've been getting into photography recently. I've seen some amazing places and taken some great shots. Would you like to see them?
[S27T2] (dia_id: D27:2)

Calvin: Yeah, show me what you got!
[S27T3] (dia_id: D27:3)

Dave: Look at this magnificent sunset I captured on camera. It's truly breathtaking to witness such beautiful sunsets! The sky looks like it's on fire!
[Image caption: a photo of a city skyline at sunset with a clock tower]
[S27T4] (dia_id: D27:4)

Calvin: Wow, that view looks awesome! What city is it? Have you taken any good pictures lately?
[S27T5] (dia_id: D27:5)

Dave: That's Boston, Cal! Check this out, I took this picture last month, and got a great shot - it was stunning!
[Image caption: a photography of a clock tower in a city with buildings]
[S27T6] (dia_id: D27:6)

Calvin: Hey Dave! Long time no talk! I had a great time yesterday, and visited some sights in Boston with a high school friend. It was really fun and eye-opening.
[S26T1] (dia_id: D26:1)

Dave: Hey Calvin! Good to hear from you! Sounds like you had a blast in Boston - so much to do there! One of my favorites there is great for chilling and admiring nature. BTW, something cool I wanted to tell you about - I recently attended a conference in Detroit - it was so cool, I learned a lot.
[S26T2] (dia_id: D26:2)

Calvin: I had a wonderful experience during my time in Boston. It had awesome architecture and a really cool history. I followed your advice and went there, it was so peaceful. Good to hear that you've learned a lot of new things at the conference in Detroit!
[S26T3] (dia_id: D26:3)

Dave: Glad you enjoyed Boston! It's got some great architecture and history. Working on this takes me out of my head and calms me down. Here's a pic of my latest car project.
[Image caption: a photography of a group of people washing a car in a garage]
[S26T4] (dia_id: D26:4)

Calvin: Dave, that car looks awesome! What got you into engineering cars? I'm totally into cars too and love making new and powerful models.
[S26T5] (dia_id: D26:5)

Dave: Thanks, Calvin! It's always been my thing. My dad took me to my first car show when I was 10, and I was wow-ed! I was hooked and wanted to learn more. Now I'm an automotive engineer and it's crazy to think that something so powerful and cool can be made from small parts.
[S26T6] (dia_id: D26:6)

Calvin: That's awesome, Dave! So happy you followed your dreams and became an engineer. Seeing you work on cars is inspiring - it makes me want to keep pushing my music. Check this out - a pic of me performing with someone I admire! So amazing!
[Image caption: a photo of a dj in a nightclub with a dj table]
[S26T7] (dia_id: D26:7)

Dave: Wow, Calvin! That's amazing! You looked super comfortable on stage. Bet it was an incredible experience to perform with someone you admire. How did it feel being up there?
[S26T8] (dia_id: D26:8)

Calvin: It was unreal, Dave. Being up there with someone I admire - it was a dream come true. The energy, the crowd - it made me realize how much music means to me, it's like my passion and my purpose.
[S26T9] (dia_id: D26:9)

Dave: That's great, Calvin. We both have discovered something that brings us fulfillment. It's a fortunate thing for us.
[S26T10] (dia_id: D26:10)
